goal: Our workflow's recent runs look weak — set up a review queue for the flagged traces and kick off a workflow calibration.

expected_steps.interaction: input form (Aria needs information): enter name + questions from review-queues/triage-review.queue.json, then Approve
input form: enter REAL flagged trace_ids of the weak runs (enqueue.json), then Approve; queue_id is linked from the previous step

input form: enter a REAL existing workflow_id + agent_id (calibrate.json), then Approve; approving enqueues the async job and the plan PARKS (waiting_job) until the plan worker (or POST /aria/plans/{id}/poll) sees the refinement job reach candidate_ready/applied

notes: review_queue.add_items depends on review_queue.create (its queue_id is linked by the planner); workflow.calibrate has no dependency, and you fill the forms in step order. review_queue.add_items + workflow.calibrate operate on EXISTING ids (traces, workflow, agent) — Aria does not create them. The final step is asynchronous: the plan parks until the job is done (the worker resumes it automatically), then completes.
